# Rafeeq · رفيق

> Rafeeq (رفيق) is a free, bilingual (Arabic/English), non-medical companion app for inflammatory bowel disease (Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis): symptom, diet and FODMAP tracking, medication reminders, labs, and a clinician report. Published by the Saudi Gastroenterology Association (SGA). Educational and self-management support only; it is not a medical device and does not replace a clinician.

## Key pages
- [Rafeeq app](https://rafeeq.saudigastro.com/): the installable web app
- [Saudi Gastroenterology Association](https://www.saudigastro.com/): the society behind this app
- [All SGA patient apps](https://www.saudigastro.com/patients): Rafeeq (IBD), Maeen (EoE), Khali (celiac), Kabidi (liver), Qawam (weight), Barem (child health)
